reading.title: A Quiet Life
reading.text: My grandfather, Karim, has led a quiet life in a small village. He earns a living by growing apples and selling them at the local market. For him, farming is not just a job but a way of life. Last year he fell ill, and a young doctor saved his life. Since then, he says he wants to enjoy the rest of his life with his family. He is seventy-eight years old, but he is still full of life. Every evening he tells us stories about his long life.

listening.title: Changing My Life
listening.script: Hi, I am Dana. Two years ago I decided to change my life. I used to work in an office, but I did not enjoy it. I wanted a job with more meaning, so I started to study to become a nurse. It was hard, but I am glad I did it. Now I help people every day and I feel that my work is important. My parents say I look much happier. I think I will keep this way of life for the rest of my life.

reading.title: A Sad Day
reading.text: Last week our neighbour, Mr Aziz, died peacefully at the age of ninety. His death was not sudden, because he had been ill for some time. Many people attended the funeral to pay their respects to his family. His grandchildren read a short poem about him. The family was in mourning for several days, and neighbours brought food to their house. I did not know him well, but my mother says he was a kind man who always helped others. We will remember him for a long time.

listening.script: Teacher: Today we will talk about a sad subject. In many cultures, people attend a funeral when someone dies. They pay their respects and support the family. reading.title: Three Generations
reading.text: There are three generations in our family. My grandfather is eighty and now enjoys a quiet old age. My parents are middle-aged and both work hard. I am sixteen, and my little brother is only six. He started school at the age of six, and he loves it. My cousin and I are the same age, so we spend a lot of time together. Next year I will come of age, and I will be allowed to vote in some countries. My grandmother says she does not feel her age, and she still walks to the market every day.

reading.title: My Best Friend
reading.text: My best friend, Laura, has a lovely character. She is kind-hearted and always ready to help. She also has a good sense of humour, so she makes everybody laugh. At first she was shy, but now she is confident when she speaks in class. She never loses her temper, even when our team loses a game. reading.title: My Morning Routine
reading.text: I have a simple daily routine, and it helps me feel calm. I get up at six and drink a glass of water out of habit. Then I do some exercise, and I try to do it regularly. After breakfast I walk to school with my brother. I used to stay up late, but I broke that bad habit last year. Now I go to bed at ten, and I read for twenty minutes. When we go on holiday, we get out of our routine, but I always enjoy it. Good habits make life easier.
